_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail on the pattern of the Paper egg (minecraft-paper.yaml): the jar from PaperMC's Fill API v3 (project folia) with its SHA-256 checked, latest meaning the newest Minecraft version with a stable build, a version or build that does not exist fails the install, the eula flag (the panel asks the owner on the first start, nothing is pre-accepted), Java 25 to 17 images (Folia starts at 1.19.4), a User Agent variable staff set once like Paper's, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. No idle sleep: Folia is for servers too large to pause.
name: Folia
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Folia is PaperMC's fork of Paper that runs regions of the world on several threads, for very large servers. Many Paper plugins do not support it.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Folia installation (Octail): the jar from PaperMC's download service (Fill API v3, project folia),
# its SHA-256 checked. "latest" picks the newest Minecraft version with a stable Folia build (the
# newest one when none is stable yet). A version or build that doesn't exist fails the install.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu

API=https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/folia
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
BUILD="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}

if [ -z "${USER_AGENT:-}" ]; then
	fail "PaperMC's download service needs a User-Agent: staff set the egg's User Agent variable (see https://docs.papermc.io/misc/downloads-service/)"
fi
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" "$1"; }

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

PROJECT_JSON=$(get "${API}") || fail "can't reach PaperMC's download service (${API})"
# Newest first: the version groups ("26.2", "1.21", ...) and the versions in each.
ALL=$(echo "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '.versions | to_entries[] | .value[]')
[ -n "${ALL}" ] || fail "PaperMC lists no Folia versions"

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
	VERSION=""
	for v in ${ALL}; do
		CHANNEL=$(get "${API}/versions/${v}/builds/latest" | jq -r '.channel // empty') || CHANNEL=""
		if [ "${CHANNEL}" = "STABLE" ]; then
			VERSION="${v}"
			break
		fi
	done
	if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
		VERSION=$(echo "${ALL}" | head -n 1)
		echo "No Minecraft version has a stable Folia build yet; using ${VERSION}."
	fi
fi
echo "${ALL}" | grep -qxF "${VERSION}" ||
	fail "Folia has no Minecraft ${VERSION}. The versions are listed at https://papermc.io/downloads/folia"

if [ -z "${BUILD}" ] || [ "${BUILD}" = "latest" ]; then
	BUILD_URL="${API}/versions/${VERSION}/builds/latest"
else
	case "${BUILD}" in
	*[!0-9]*) fail "the build number (${BUILD}) must be a number or latest" ;;
	esac
	BUILD_URL="${API}/versions/${VERSION}/builds/${BUILD}"
fi
INFO=$(get "${BUILD_URL}") || fail "Folia has no build ${BUILD} for ${VERSION}"
BUILD=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.id // empty')
CHANNEL=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.channel // empty')
URL=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url // empty')
SHA256=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".checksums.sha256 // empty' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
case "${URL}" in
https://*) ;;
*) fail "PaperMC gave no download for Folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD}" ;;
esac
echo "${SHA256}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' || fail "PaperMC gave no SHA-256 for Folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD}"
if [ "${CHANNEL}" != "STABLE" ]; then
	echo "Note: Folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} is marked ${CHANNEL}, not stable."
fi

echo "Installing Folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" -o "${JAR}.download" "${URL}" ||
	fail "the download of Folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} failed"
GOT=$(sha256sum "${JAR}.download" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SHA256}" ]; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "SHA-256 mismatch for Folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} (expected ${SHA256}, got ${GOT})"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"

echo "Folia ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} installed (SHA-256 checked)."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version to install, such as 1.21.11, or latest for the newest version with a stable Folia build. A version Folia has no build for fails the install.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 25 for the newest releases, Java 21 for 1.20.5 to 1.21.x, Java 17 for 1.19.4 to 1.20.4.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: The Folia build to install, or latest for the newest build of that Minecraft version.

variables.name: User Agent
variables.description:
Required by PaperMC's download service: something that identifies your panel, such as Octail/1.0 (https://panel.example.com).
See https://docs.papermc.io/misc/downloads-service/
